entry.title: FortiCare Release Roll Out
entry.content:
Feb 1, 20:00 PST
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Jan 28, 10:02 PST
Scheduled - FortiCare 2025 Q1 Release.
From 4:00PM to 8:00PM PST on Feb 1st, 2025.

During the system deployment period, all FortiCare application users may experience session time out and need re-login.
